field.name: initialState
field.comment: openfirst: the first item is expanded when the page is displayed; closed: every item is collapsed; open: every item is expanded

field.name: itemHeadingFormat
field.comment: The HTML element wrapping the title of the items: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 or p

field.name: alwaysOpen
field.comment: true: the items stay open when another one is opened; false or NULL: opening an item closes the other ones

field.name: flush
field.comment: true: the accordion is rendered edge-to-edge, without borders and rounded corners; false or NULL: it keeps them

field.name: title
field.comment: The title of the item, displayed in its header

field.name: sortOrder
field.comment: The position of the item in the accordion, starting from zero

field.name: description
field.comment: The contents of the item, as rich text
